newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK Electric says Hutchison bid undervalues company.
newsitem.headline: HK Electric says Hutchison bid undervalues company.

text.p: An independent board committee of Hongkong Electric Holdings Ltd said Hutichison Whampoa Ltd's bid to acquire its issued share capital undervalued the company.

It also said in a statement on Friday that its directors estimate profit after taxation for the year ended December 31, 1996 of not less than HK$4.15 billion compared with HK$4.19 billion in 1995. It said the estimate has been reviewed by the company's auditor KPMG Peat Marwick.

"Shareholders are strongly advised to take no action with regard to the offer until they have received the response document and considered the advice from Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and the Independent Board Committee," the statement said.

Hutchison is making a general offer for Hongkong Electric at HK$26.50 per share as part of a group reorganisation which also involves Cheung Kong (Holdings) Ltd and Cheung Kong Infrastructure Holdings Ltd.
Hongkong Electric shares closed at HK$27.00 on Thursday. Hutchison closed at HK$64.00.
